history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration intensify efforts to coordinate with programme budget entities to sufficiently disclose all the posts and financial resources required, including both regular budget and extrabudgetary resources, in the budget documents to allow for enhanced oversight, transparency and accountability.
history.administration_response: In the context of the proposed programme budget for 2024, the information on extrabudgetary resources includes: (a) actual extrabudgetary expenditures in 2022; (b) estimated extrabudgetary resources in 2023; (c) estimated extrabudgetary resources in 2024; (d) main reasons for the variances in estimated resources; (e) the number of extrabudgetary posts and their distribution in the organizational charts; (f) explanations of the functions of the posts funded by extrabudgetary resources; (g) information on the planned use of extrabudgetary resources; and (h) oversight mechanisms for extrabudgetary resources. The General Assembly, in paragraph 29 of its resolution 77/262, took note of the recommendation of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions in paragraph 75 of its report (A/77/7) and therefore rejected the Advisory Committee’s recommendation requesting more detailed extrabudgetary information in the budget. Considering the information currently provided in the proposed programme budget and the decision of the Assembly, the Administration requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that enhancements regarding the disclosure of the financial resources required from regular budget and extrabudgetary sources are included in the proposed programme budget for 2024, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
